# Turn the Page — flow audit

*Generated by `tests/flow-audit.mjs` from `src/content/maya.js` and the engine. The ratings in the last three columns are written by hand and kept when the file is regenerated; everything else is regenerated. The script fails if a pair has no rating.*

Each row is one way into a page: the option chosen on the page before, Maya's reaction to it (the one she actually gives with her trait bands in that round), and the page it leads to. Only destinations some path actually reaches are listed (all branches of a route that depends on the meters, and the end of the round, including an Early exit after any decision that can end it). Rows are grouped by destination, so all the ways into a page sit together. When an act banner sits between the two pages, the destination heading gives its cliffhanger.

**Round 2 bands.** Maya's readiness for change is `mid` in Round 2 after a Round 1 Breakthrough or Partial and `low` after a Polite or Early exit. Each Round 2 pair is listed once per band it occurs in (`@mid`, `@low`), with the Round 1 endings it was reached after. Her other bands do not change (confidence `low`, extraversion `mid`, defensiveness `mid`).

**Ratings.** `fits`: the next line follows naturally. `bridge`: the page works, but its opening line (and if needed its cue) needs a variant for this way in; the draft is in the last column. `branch`: no line on the existing page can follow this reaction; the last column says what the new page would be, its act and where it rejoins.

## Notes

<!-- notes: hand-written, kept on regeneration -->
Session 7 audit, Part 1 (no content changed). Rated by reading every row.

**Totals.** Round 1: 300 pairs, 208 fits, 92 bridge, 0 branch (into pages: 163 fits, 40 bridge; into endings: 45 fits, 52 bridge). Round 2: 170 pairs, 136 fits, 34 bridge, 0 branch (into pages: 103 fits, 21 bridge; into endings: 33 fits, 13 bridge).

**No branch pages proposed.** Every jump into a page can be fixed by a variant opening line or cue that keeps what the page's options respond to (for example, p. 40 options answer "can't be bothered", and p. 70 options answer a request for a plan, so every variant keeps those).

**Endings need the same mechanism.** 65 of the 126 bridges lead into an ending, not a page. The ending is chosen by the meters, but the last reaction is fixed per option, so a reaction can contradict the ending (she proposes her own step, then the Polite exit says nothing changed; she says "the problem is yours now", then the Breakthrough says she proposes her own step). The variants drafted for those rows are ending texts. SPEC.md 9.5 as briefed covers page `line` and `cue` only; building these needs the same `{ default, from }` shape on an ending's `text`.

**Round 1 Early exit text.** "The conversation is over before it really began" is shown after exits in Act 3 (pp. 51-70), where the conversation plainly had begun. Those rows are rated bridge with a late-session variant.

**Page-level issues found (not pair-specific).**
- p. 36 cue: "When she mentions next year's exams, she takes out her phone", but her line on that page does not mention exams. p. 40 cue: "Each time you mention exams or next year", but no earlier counsellor line on any path mentions either.
- Round 2 Act 2 cliffhanger, "She had never said it out loud before. Not even to herself.", is shown before p. 127 (after Support closed the subject) and p. 133 ("You don't know my parents."), where she has not said anything new.
- p. 45: the three Challenge wordings all open "Maybe.", answering "Everyone's already decided what I'm doing" with agreement. Not a flow pair, noted for review.
